result.statement: For every 4x4 unitary U, the signed complementary-pair orientation data d_{alpha,beta}=q_{S_alpha,T_beta}-q_{S_alpha,T_beta^c} are exactly determined by the one-minor matrix P=|U|^2 via d_{alpha,beta}=sum_{i in S_alpha,j in T_beta}P_ij-1=(1/4)h_alpha^T P h_beta. Consequently the full MOC4 support functional has the exact parity-free form C0+<P,C>+(1/2)<R,X>, and MOC4 reduces to one structured mixed P/R assignment inequality over the six induced pair-class actions of S4.
additional_constraints: rowwise and columnwise Plucker triangle constraints on sqrt(r_{alpha,beta}^2-d_{alpha,beta}^2)
result.effect_on_previous_gap: Eliminates the independent orientation-parity penalty from MOC4-C2-COMPLEMENT-BOUND-v1; the remaining universal gap is joint coupling of P and R for the structured support coefficients, not an independent sign-parity relaxation.

consumed_peer.use: Used the partner's repeated-spectrum exact lift as the boundary case and as evidence that the mixed assignment inequality is valid on every repeated-eigenvalue face.

additional_lineage_consumed.use: Sharpened its complementary-pair decomposition by identifying D exactly as a linear image of P.
Respected the exact obstruction to a spectrum-independent common permutation lift; the new reduction does not assume such a lift.
Respected the stronger obstruction to P-preserving spectrum-dependent weights; the new reduction is only a support inequality.

verification.scope: Consistency certificate on the shared exact rational orthogonal test case; not a proof of the remaining mixed assignment inequality.

remaining_obligation: Prove MOC4-MIXED-ASSIGNMENT-v1 for every unitary-derived (P,R) and every structured spectral/support coefficient pair (C,X), using the exact Hadamard, quadratic interval and Plucker constraints, or produce a genuine unitary/spectrum/support counterexample to that exact inequality.
